programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u064/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    frame = grid[0][0]
    left_w = next(c for c in range(1, w) if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r in range(h)))

    def normalize(points):
        min_r = min(r for r, c in points)
        min_c = min(c for r, c in points)
        return frozenset((r - min_r, c - min_c) for r, c in points)

    shapes = {}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(left_w + 1, w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color != 0 and color != frame:
                shapes.setdefault(color, set()).add((r, c))
    shape_by_color = {color: normalize(points) for color, points in shapes.items()}

    out = [row[:left_w] for row in grid]
    r = 0
    while r < h:
        if all(grid[r][c] == frame for c in range(left_w)):
            r += 1
            continue
        start = r
        while r < h and not all(grid[r][c] == frame for c in range(left_w)):
            r += 1
        points = [(rr, c) for rr in range(start, r)
                  for c in range(1, left_w - 1) if grid[rr][c] == 0]
        if points:
            target = normalize(points)
            for color, shape in shape_by_color.items():
                if shape == target:
                    for rr, c in points:
                        out[rr][c] = color
                    break
    return out
'''
